text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Labour cabinet sworn in. New Prime Minister Alfred Sant has appointed 14 ministers and five parliamentary secretaries.
- Former prime minister Fenech Adami mentioned the introduction of VAT tax and drive to eradicate tax evasion as reasons for his party's defeat on Saturday.
- Fenech Adami calls meeting of Nationalist Party council next week to confirm his leadership.
- Malta withdraws from NATO Partnership for Peace.
